newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS prices slip as crude meets resistance.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS prices slip as crude meets resistance.

text.p: U.S. energy futures prices slipped during Monday's ACCESS session as crude oil failed to break through a key price level and activity dried up ahead of the New Year's Holiday, traders said.
The overnight market saw NYMEX February crude trade $25.28 a barrel, down nine cents from the daytime settlement. About 264 lots traded in February and 315 overall.
Pressure came after February crude stayed under a reistance level of $25.50 in day trade.
One trader said crude would turn lower Tueday but find support around $25 a barrel.
"Tonight, we're seeing good interest below the (daytime) market," he said.
NYMEX heating oil futures for January edged down 0.02 cents a gallon to to 70.55 cents, as volume thinned to 113 lots.
NYMEX January gasoline futures shed 11 cents a gallon to 69.50 amid a light 53 lots exchanged.
